item.title: Apex Files: Honey Badger Wars Part 4 — "What They Try Instead
item.description:
Follow a honey badger mother on a tense journey as she moves her cub, only to find a jackal waiting on her path.
In this fourth installment of the Apex Files series, we analyze rare tracking collar footage capturing a critical moment of survival. For six straight nights, the local jackal pack had stayed away from the den, leading researchers to believe they had abandoned their pursuit. However, this footage reveals a different strategy as a honey badger navigates a path previously thought to be safe.
This wildlife documentary provides a close look at how these predators adapt their tactics when traditional hunting methods fail. By observing this specific animal behavior, we gain insight into the high-stakes game of territory and cub protection that defines life in the African savanna for every honey badger.
Chapters 0:00 – The Failed Charge 0:52 – Why Direct Attacks Keep Failing 2:40 – Act 1: The jackals Change Strategy

item.title: Africa's Deadliest Predators: 2 Hours of Real Kill-or-Be-Killed Encounters
item.description:
Two hours inside the most dangerous stretch of wilderness on Earth — where every encounter comes down to one rule: kill or be killed.
This compilation brings together our most intense predator confrontations from across the Apex Files and Africa's Hierarchy series: lions, crocodiles, leopards, hyenas, and the honey badger that's outlasted all of them. Real footage, real behavior, no dramatization beyond what the science supports.
